stories.summary: Net profit for July–September fell from S$2.95 billion a year earlier as markets trading income plunged 65% to S$152 million; net interest income rose 4% to S$3.71 billion and a total dividend of S$0.81 per share was declared.
stories.title: DBS Q3 profit falls 5% to S$2.81 billion, missing forecasts
stories.why: Singapore's biggest bank is a bellwether for the local economy, and the miss shows how market volatility is now hitting even its strongest lenders.

stories.summary: The Transboundary Haze Pollution (Amendment) Bill was passed unanimously after a six-hour debate involving 24 MPs, raising maximum fines to S$20 million; the minister cautioned that international cooperation remains crucial.
stories.title: Haze law 'not a silver bullet', Grace Fu tells Parliament
stories.why: It closes the follow-up to Singapore's worst haze since 2015, with enforcement powers now expanded but the cross-border problem still unresolved.

stories.summary: The three new stations link the Thomson-East Coast and Downtown lines, cutting some journeys by up to 25 minutes.
stories.title: Bedok South, Xilin and Sungei Bedok MRT stations to open 26 Dec
stories.why: It completes a long-awaited east-side connection and changes commuting options for Bedok and Upper East Coast residents.

stories.summary: Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom and Search will be off for K-12 student accounts until school administrators switch them on; schools that want Search must accept its AI features with it.
stories.title: Google turns off AI for schoolchildren by default
stories.why: It is the biggest school-AI policy shift yet from a major platform, and it forces every school to make an explicit choice about AI in class.

stories.summary: SES demonstrated a bi-directional optical link between a ground station in Rennes, France, and an SES payload on K2's GRAVITAS mission, transmitting video messages from its CEO over a laser link.
stories.title: SES achieves optical communications milestone for future meoSphere network
stories.why: Laser links are a core building block for the next generation of high-capacity, secure satellite networks.

stories.summary: Motorola's new flagship is tipped with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip, a 200MP periscope camera, a 6.8-inch Tandem OLED display and Audio by Bang & Olufsen, with seven years of updates promised.
stories.title: Motorola Signature 27 launches globally on 5 November
stories.why: It is Motorola's most serious premium push yet, testing whether it can compete at the top end beyond its mid-range strength.

stories.summary: The Dow rallied 3% to 53,356.12, its best day since April 2025, the S&P 500 rose 1.6% and the Nasdaq 1.4%, after Democrats won majorities in both houses of Congress; Brent crude fell to $94.63.
stories.title: Dow jumps 1,569 points after the midterms as oil plunges below $95
stories.why: Markets read the result as clearing political uncertainty, and the rally sets the tone for the rest of the week's central-bank decisions.

stories.summary: The Bank is expected to join most G10 peers in raising borrowing costs to fight inflation, its first hike in more than three years, with around 100 basis points of tightening priced in by the end of next year.
stories.title: Bank of England expected to raise rates on Thursday
stories.why: A hike would widen the UK's already-high real-rate gap and move sterling, gilts and mortgage pricing.

stories.summary: Oracle cancelled a five-year deal that would have given Tencent access to about 100,000 advanced AI chips through data centres in South-east Asia, after US officials raised concerns; neither company has confirmed the cancellation publicly.
stories.title: Oracle scraps US$7 billion deal to lease chips to Tencent
stories.why: It shows Washington's chip curbs now biting through commercial pressure, not just export rules, and removes a large contracted revenue stream from Oracle's AI build-out.

stories.summary: KCNA said the test confirmed the system's technical specifications, target identification and tracking, and detection data processing; a long-range cruise-missile unit also struck a virtual airport target. South Korea detected multiple missiles fired from Sondok toward the East Sea.
stories.title: North Korea test-fires new air-defence missile system and stages cruise-missile drill
stories.why: It is the fourth North Korean weapons launch in a month, in a run that also includes cluster munitions, drones and a hypersonic missile.

stories.summary: PNG Defence Force soldiers joined the Australian Army's 3rd Brigade in Townsville, including the PNGDF's first participation in a multinational mortar live-fire activity, under the new Pukpuk Treaty partnership.
stories.title: Exercise Wantok Warrior strengthens PNG–Australia defence partnership
stories.why: It is a concrete step in Australia's Pacific defence posture and in PNG's capability development.

stories.summary: Trump said he is in no hurry to decide on resuming military operations against Iran, claiming Tehran wants a negotiated settlement, while Qatari mediators have prepared a draft sequence of confidence-building measures.
stories.title: Trump says Iran wants a deal 'more than ever' as US weighs next move
stories.why: The standoff is the key driver of oil prices and of the post-midterm debate over US military action in the region.

stories.summary: After the US midterms, a viral post claimed an FBI raid in Houston uncovered more than 20,000 fake Democratic ballots; the FBI said the information is false and no election-related operation occurred, and the photos used did not support the claim.
stories.title: FBI refutes claim of 20,000 fake ballots in Houston
stories.why: It is the clearest post-election fraud falsehood to be formally debunked, and it shows how quickly a fabricated raid story can travel.

stories.summary: More than 250 participants from over 40 countries in Tallinn are building, deploying and operating alongside AI agents, using locally hosted AI and OpenAI's Daybreak, while coordinating cyber effects with kinetic action in minutes rather than hours.
stories.title: NATO's Crossed Swords exercise adds AI agents to cyber training for the first time
stories.why: It is the first time AI agents have entered NATO cyber-operations training, a shift with direct implications for how future cyber conflicts are fought.

stories.summary: ESET named the group SlippyNunchucks: DNS hijacking redirected Sogou Input Method's unencrypted brand-promotion requests to attacker servers, delivering the DarkVigil toolset to users in six countries; Tencent patched the flaw in version 16.10.
stories.title: China-aligned group abuses Sogou Input Method to deliver malware
stories.why: It turns a trusted everyday app into a surveillance delivery channel, and it is a textbook case of why unencrypted app traffic matters.

tldr: Singapore: DBS Q3 profit fell 5% to S$2.81 billion, missing forecasts as trading income plunged.
Technology: Google will switch its AI tools off by default for schoolchildren until schools opt in.
Finance: The Dow jumped 1,569 points after Democrats swept both houses in the US midterms; the Bank of England is expected to raise rates today.
Defence: North Korea test-fired a new air-defence missile system and staged a cruise-missile drill.
Info ops: The FBI debunked a viral claim of 20,000 fake ballots found in Houston after the US midterms.
